headline: LIONESS-PANDA fits your goal: cohort-level TF-gene regulatory network.
points: Method: One TF-gene network per sample, derived leave-one-out from the cohort.
Needs: expression matrix, motif prior, PPI network.
Cost: N samples take N+1 PANDA runs (for your 30 samples, 31 PANDA runs).
It also writes the cohort network, so PANDA need not run first.
